scientific_findings: DOMAIN_TRANSFER_GENERALIZATION: DMCT-Net (0.2532 Pearson, 0.3028 Spearman) and BiLSTM (0.2690 Pearson, 0.3132 Spearman) demonstrate the most robust out-of-domain transfer on SpeechOcean762, successfully bridging across adult/child acoustic domains.

SUBFRAME_CALIBRATION_SHIFT: HRTD-Net sub-frame dynamics exhibit slight distribution shift (0.1731 Pearson) due to child vocal tract differences in SpeechOcean762, indicating that age-invariant normalization (such as VTLN from EXP-42) should be combined with 5ms sub-frame dynamics.
